name: Cupped Hardwood Floors in Everett: Causes, and Whether Refinishing Fixes It
title-tag: Cupped Hardwood Floors in Everett, WA: Causes and Fixes
meta-description: Cupped, washboard hardwood is a moisture problem. An Everett refinishing contractor explains the causes, why sanding too soon backfires, and the fix that lasts.
post-summary: October 21, 2026 · Cupping means the bottom of each board is wetter than the top — almost always from below, and in Everett usually the crawlspace. Refinishing erases it, but only after the source is fixed and the wood is verified dry; sand too soon and you buy permanent crowning. The full order of operations, with severity table and real prices.
